why: Fix round for slice F of the exam-to-lint plan (0591, docs/plan/quests/exam-to-lint-PLAN.md), after the review's first send-back (field/runs/2026-11-16-591-f-review.json), on fabrikalfa/exam-to-lint-f from d4d9cc4. The review found that fabrika/one-page-runtime (oxlint-plugins/one-page-runtime.ts) passed three second page runtimes that the deleted next/apps/fabrika/src/build.test.ts law refused, a loosened law. The fix: the rule now counts every import specifier whose imported name is runMain, from any module and under any local name, allows exactly one (from @kampus/tuval/browser, under its own name) and reports each other one where it stands; and a computed member property spelled by a string literal or a template with no expressions is read as the same name written plainly, so a run* name there is reported and a runMain there is a second runtime. The line 11 comment that said aliases are not traced is gone, and oxlint-plugins/README.md now says what the rule counts and names the seven planted breaks. M7's law (oxlint-plugins/one-page-runtime.test.ts) gains the three cases as generated planted entries: a renamed second import of runMain from @kampus/tuval/browser started under the alias, runMain renamed from a generated other module and started under the alias, and a run function read by a string key in four spellings (double quotes, single quotes, a template, and runMain itself, which must report a second runtime). The property states its coverage: each start spelling and each string key spelling must be drawn.

note: Each case was checked once at 2026-11-15T23:01 in a scratch file oxlint-plugins/zz-cases.test.ts beside a copy of the rule from 031b8d8; both were deleted after the run and never committed. The fixed rule reported each case once; the old rule gave each case no report, so the three new cases are what catch the loosening. Against the old rule, the new law failed with 'Should have 1 error but had 0' on the string-key case, and the scenario with 'a renamed second import: expected [] to have a length of 1'. M7's planned break was run once on a saved copy and restored by copy, checked with cmp; it fails 'inside a component' with 'Should have 2 errors but had 0'. M5: pnpm lint (NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144) exits 0, 17 parts passed, and oxlint on the real entry next/apps/fabrika/src/entry/browser.tsx gives 0 diagnostics; the entry is unchanged. Tests ran under nice -n 19 with --maxWorkers=1 on narrow paths only: oxlint-plugins/one-page-runtime.test.ts (2 passed) and oxlint-plugins/plants.test.ts (236 passed). The list ratchet exits 0. The one pnpm typecheck, started when pgrep -x tsgo found none, failed on this round's own change (one-page-runtime.ts: imported was read on a specifier type that had not been narrowed); after the fix the oxlint-plugins package typecheck (tsc --noEmit -p oxlint-plugins) passes, and no second full typecheck was run. No .integration. or .visual. law was reached, so none met the 0178 guard. No product file changed.
